A '''Bug Pak''', also known as bug repeller, was a device worn over the head as an insect repellent. The device included a power supply worn on the back and projected a [[Force field/Legends|force field]] from above the wearer's head down to a collar.

[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and a number of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] once wore Bug Paks in the forests of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].
